name: skylight-weather-dashboard
description: Skylight — a polished, dependency-free weather dashboard with live Open-Meteo data, an animated sky that follows the real conditions, and a deterministic offline fallback.

scripts.verify: node run-tests.js && node tools/capture.js && node tools/contrast.js --theme dark && node tools/contrast.js --theme light && node tools/interact.js
scripts.shots: node tools/capture.js && node tools/inspect.js --theme dark && node tools/inspect.js --theme light
scripts.contrast: node tools/contrast.js --theme dark && node tools/contrast.js --theme light
